decision: premise checked: TimeNavigator.tsx has a log overview strip and a linear detail tape
ruled out a fisheye lens and a slow-drag magnifier; chose one fixed track with speed-based fine drag
why: 1a58490 tried a lens and fdc716d replaced it two days later; a magnifier is a second bar moving at another speed, which is Will's complaint
evidence: git show 1a58490 fdc716d; plan.md Design options

decision: scale: log of years ago with offset K=400 (old overview used 30)
why: puts 10k BCE at ~39% and 1 CE at ~69%, so recent centuries stop taking 30% of the bar

decision: pure scale/step/parse/drag module with tests before any UI
why: the gestures' rules are testable without a browser; the component only wires pointers to them

decision: extracted TimeReadout from TimeNavigator so both bars share the header; old bar kept at ?bar=old
why: task asks to keep the old bar for one round; sharing keeps the header identical for comparison

decision: pressing within 16 px of the needle grabs it without jumping
why: on touch a knob-sized jump in the deep past is hundreds of years, which would defeat fine dragging

decision: drove the bar in Chromium at 1440 and 375 px with a script
why: acceptance asks for browser proof of three gestures
result: 100k->1900 one drag; 1347 typed; slow scrub 3 yrs/px desktop, 12 yrs/px phone

decision: moved the hover year from a DOM label into the label row under the track; thinned data ticks to 7 px apart
why: the DOM label overlapped the moment note; ticks read as a busy dotted line in the modelled range
